title: Homebase Project Declaration
description: Schema for <project>/.homebase/project.yml. Declares a project to homebase so it appears in registry/PROJECTS.md.

name.description: kebab-case slug; must match the project directory basename.

changelog.description: Optional. Repo-relative path to the app's CHANGELOG.md, used by scripts/hooks/commit-changelog-check.sh (HMB-26) when the changelog lives outside the default `<path>/CHANGELOG.md` location. Example for SHOPOS: 'ShopOS/Documentation/Release/CHANGELOG.md'.

extra_paths.description: Optional. Additional repo-relative roots for this app, paired with their own CHANGELOG.md when applicable. Use for multi-platform apps whose source is split across multiple roots (e.g. GasCalc with iOS/Apps/GasCalc + Android/apps/gascalc, each with its own CHANGELOG). The changelog-check hook (HMB-26) treats each entry as a sibling app root: a commit whose staged paths all live under one entry's `path` is enforced against that entry's `changelog` (default `<path>/CHANGELOG.md`).

roadmap.description: Optional. Enables HOMEBASE-SOP-013 Linear roadmap tracking for this app. Omit or set enabled:false to opt out. Linear IDs are populated by `homebase roadmap capture`; never hand-edited.

enabled.description: If false, the app is excluded from `homebase roadmap` operations.

linear_team_key.description: Linear team key (monorepo-scoped; one of TBL, TFD, HMB). See standards/LINEAR_WORKSPACE.md § Teams.

linear_team_id.description: Linear team UUID. Populated by `homebase roadmap capture`.

linear_project_id.description: Linear Project UUID — the per-app Project inside the monorepo Team. Populated by `homebase roadmap capture`.

owner_agent.description: PM agent with Project scope and priority authority.

auto_create_issues.description: Linear auto-creates a mirror GitHub issue when a Linear issue is created.

auto_close_on_pr_merge.description: PR merge referencing a Linear ID auto-closes the Linear issue.

deploy.description: Optional. Wires the app up for `homebase deploy <app> <env>`.

image.description: Container image path as <org>/<app>. The registry (typically ghcr.io) is declared separately in the Kamal config's registry.server; Kamal concatenates the two.

branch.description: Branch deploys must originate from. Defaults to main.

validate.description: Shell command run in the validate phase. Defaults to bin/ci if omitted.

path.description: Version file path, relative to the app path.

language.description: Language dispatch for version constant rewriting.

symbol.description: Optional display-only name for the constant, e.g. StudioWeb::VERSION.

envs.description: Deployment environments (production, staging, ...). At least one required.

traefik_host.description: Public hostname served by kamal-proxy (for display and health checks).

kamal_config.description: Path to the Kamal config for this env, relative to the app path.

secrets_file.description: Optional. Path to the .kamal/secrets.<env> file. Defaults to .kamal/secrets.<env>.

health_url.description: Optional. Post-deploy HTTP probe URL; must return 2xx.

ship.description: Optional. Wires the app up for 'homebase work ship <app> <version> <target>'. Mobile/desktop counterpart to the web 'deploy' stanza. The target name → fastlane lane invocation map lives under 'targets'; pre-flight checks (CHANGELOG header, version-file constant) are driven from 'version_file' and 'validate_lane'.

tool.description: Toolchain that the verb invokes. Only 'fastlane' today; future entries (e.g. 'sparkle') would land here when their pre-flight + invocation contract is defined.

fastlane_root.description: Repo-relative path to the fastlane root (the directory containing the Fastfile). Defaults to 'fastlane'.

validate_lane.description: Optional fastlane lane name to run as a pre-flight (e.g. 'validate'). Skipped when --skip-validation is passed.

branch.description: Branch ships must originate from. Defaults to main. Mirrors deploy.branch.

version_file.description: Path + language of the version constant the verb checks before invoking fastlane.

path.description: Version file path, relative to the app path.

language.description: Format dispatch for version-constant reading. `pbxproj` reads MARKETING_VERSION-style keys from <app>.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj build settings (HMB-71).

targets.description: Per-target fastlane invocation map. Target name (kebab-case) → fastlane app + track + tier. The schema's tag_platform optional override lets one fastlane platform (e.g. ios) ship to multiple stores (e.g. tag form 'gascalc/macos/1.2.0' for the Mac App Store under platform:ios).

fastlane_app.description: Value passed as app: to fastlane (may differ from the project.yml app name; e.g. gascalc-mac for GasCalc's macOS slice).

platform.description: Fastlane's platform vocabulary. macOS is platform:ios + store_platform:osx in AppConfig — use tag_platform: macos to override the tag segment.

track.description: Value passed as track: to fastlane (testflight | appstore | internal | alpha | beta | production | artifacts).

tier.description: Charter tier. red requires HOMEBASE_SHIP_CONFIRMED=1 at the terminal (operator-only env var; not capturable in .claude/settings.local.json's env block).

tag_platform.description: Override for the {platform} segment of the git tag <app>/<platform>/<version>. Defaults to platform; set to 'macos' when shipping macOS under platform:ios.

worktree.description: Optional. Opts the project into per-task git-worktree isolation (HMB-27). When enabled, `homebase work start <KEY>` creates a worktree at <project>/.worktrees/<branch>/ instead of branching in the project root, so multiple agents on the same project can run in parallel without colliding on tree state, work-state.json, .work-env, or the dev/test database.

enabled.description: If true, `homebase work start` creates a per-task worktree. Single-branch flow is preserved when false or absent.

share.description: Repo-relative paths from the main checkout to symlink into each new worktree (e.g. `vendor/bundle`, `node_modules`, `tmp/cache`). Trades a small version-skew risk during big migrations for fast `work start` times.

db_suffix_env.description: Name of the environment variable carrying the per-worktree database suffix (default `WORKTREE_DB_SUFFIX`). The app's `database.yml` reads it: `database: foo_dev<%= ENV.fetch("WORKTREE_DB_SUFFIX", "") %>`.

setup_command.description: Shell command run inside the worktree after creation, with the per-worktree DB suffix already exported. Typical: `bin/rails db:create db:migrate db:seed`.

teardown_command.description: Shell command run inside the worktree before `git worktree remove` on finish/cancel, with the per-worktree DB suffix exported. Typical: `bin/rails db:drop`.
